1_standard_shortlist.label: Scenario 1 - Standard eligible shortlist (success case)
1_standard_shortlist.description: Normal sourcing decision. Several suppliers pass; the copilot ranks them and explains why.

2_ambiguous_conflict.label: Scenario 2 - Ambiguous / conflicting lead-time data
2_ambiguous_conflict.description: Requirements loosened so a borderline supplier (S3) becomes a contender — but its quotation lead time conflicts with its profile lead time. The copilot flags the conflict instead of silently trusting one number.

3_all_fail_fallback.label: Scenario 3 - Complete constraint failure (fallback case)
3_all_fail_fallback.description: A mandatory certification (UL) that no supplier holds. Every supplier fails the eligibility screen; the copilot returns a safe 'no eligible supplier' state rather than forcing a recommendation.
